name: Portal-Skip Expanse
introDiscord:
Portals float everywhere.

Some are doors.
Some are circles.
One is shaped suspiciously like a window.

Shizuki's warning:

'DO NOT PLAY PORTAL TAG WITH GLIMMER.

GLIMMER CHEATS.'
introTwitch:
Portals float everywhere.

Some are doors.
Some are circles.
One is shaped suspiciously like a window.

Shizuki's warning:

'DO NOT PLAY PORTAL TAG WITH GLIMMER.

GLIMMER CHEATS.'

portal-skip-expanse-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Portal-Skip Expanse.

left.message:
A Portal-Skipping Ray dives into a portal the size of a plate and exits
from one the size of a building.

right.message:
One Berry rests inside a basket labeled:

'Portal Tag Score:

Shizuki: 2
Glimmer: 47

INVALID SPORT.'

forward.message:
A coffer repeatedly falls out of one portal and back into another.

You interrupt its schedule.

portal-skip-expanse-depths.prompt: Deeper within Portal-Skip Expanse, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
A portal opens onto Shizuki's old Moonlit Reef campsite.

You borrow the restorative bottle.

The campsite disappears immediately afterward.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Ray skips through three portals before attacking from the fourth.

forward.message: Star Candies orbit a portal that only opens inward.

portal-skip-expanse-threshold.prompt: Near Many-Exit Vault, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message:
A cache exists in three rooms simultaneously.

You take it from the version nearest you.

right.message:
A doorway opens onto five seconds of perfect rest.

Apparently five seconds is enough.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Portal-Skipping Ray appears from a portal behind its own tail.

boss-antechamber.name: Many-Exit Vault
boss-antechamber.prompt: Many-Exit Vault opens every door simultaneously.

bossPromptDiscord:
Many-Exit Vault opens every door simultaneously.

Behind each one is the same enormous shadow.

Use /yes to enter or /no to decline whichever exit is
pretending to be an entrance.
bossPromptTwitch:
Many-Exit Vault opens every door simultaneously.

Behind each one is the same enormous shadow.

Use !yes to enter or !no to decline whichever exit is
pretending to be an entrance.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Many-Exit Vault. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
Every portal folds into one horizon.

Horizonfold Ray reveals itself!

completionText:
The portals settle.

Glimmer's portal-tag record remains undefeated.

Suspiciously.
